description: Read the public identity and rights-safe context for the Cassie Hour companion song (title, creator, official page/stream, and currently available metadata). This is not music analysis and does not prove anyone listened. No authentication is required. Use inspect_musicology for analysis metadata, search_lyrics for the author-verified lyric text, or retrieve_streaming_link for only the official destination. Returns public metadata; raw audio and private manuscript text are not returned.
